discovery_notes: These are selected seed assets, not a claim that every relevant Wikipedia page, DeepWiki repository or arXiv paper has been harvested.
DeepWiki indexed content must be tied to an upstream repository commit and corroborated against the source files it cites.
Wikipedia pages must be pinned to a MediaWiki revision ID and timestamp before use in reproducible evidence.
arXiv works must be stored by identifier and version; DOI verification and peer-review status are independent fields.
Continue discovery from the engineering-library catalogue and the three-discipline taxonomy; avoid unrestricted bulk copying.
